_doc: District detection rules. Each rule group applies to facilities whose governorate is listed. 'strong' rules (explicit area names) are tried on the address then the name; 'weak' rules (streets, landmarks) only on the address and only if no strong rule matched. The LAST match in the text wins. A rule's third value limits it to facilities listed under that governorate (null = any). 'district_gov' maps each district to its real governorate (fixes facilities filed under the wrong one). 'aliases' are extra search words for a district.
